scope: Katcats.AI independent copy: actual delegated member results before dependent artifacts
behavior: Delegation awaits a distinct available member executor and a durable published result, rather than returning queued.
Delegation uses an exclusive tool batch; dependent tools in the same model response are refused regardless of call order or invalid member-request arguments.
The next model step receives actual completed replies and published message IDs before producing dependent artifacts.
Busy targets are refused without an accepted task; returning a reply resumes the waiting caller.
Failures, uncertain history, Stop and cold recovery cannot masquerade as completed member results.
Live budget and owner pauses preserve owned waits for Continue; queued new owner questions can supersede budget-blocked chains.

documentation.checks: Existing seven Katcats document pairs and eight local-link files pass; the member-results guide and README named pairs, guide format and links pass.

limitations: Deterministic integration/browser tests use explicit Mock providers; a separate short test also passed using the current real model through the normal Dev UI.
The test deliverable is Markdown. This change does not test PPTX generation or PowerPoint rendering.
No storage schema or Session event types changed. No data migration is needed.
